subject: Attending CVPR | quick coffee?
text:

subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

Here are the details:

Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?

subject: CVPR Fireside Chat + Private Dinner @ Moto Nashville, 14th June
text:
Hi [NAME],

I thought there's a good chance you'll be at CVPR this year - and if so,
I'd love to introduce myself in person. I lead Encord's work with
automotive companies like Woven by Toyota, Lucid Motors, Skydio, Autonomous
etc. We're helping their AI teams accelerate model development with
high-quality training data and improved pipeline automation, critical for
new use cases/products i.e. driver situational detection or navigating new
terrain types.

If you're in Nashville, I'd love to invite you to an exclusive fireside
chat and dinner in Nashville with Luc Vincent (ex-VP of AI at Meta, now
Chief R&D Officer at Nexar and Encord advisor). It's on Saturday, 14th June
from 6:30-9:30 pm at Moto Nashville (15-min walk from the venue).

We're capping attendance at ~25 senior AI leaders (CTOs, Heads of ML,
Co-founders..) from top orgs - confirmed guests already include execs from
MIT-IBM [SENDER] AI Lab and Toyota.

For context, Encord is a ML data development platform (Series B, $50M
raised) powering advanced CV and multimodal AI teams. We're focused on
consolidating data curation, annotation, workflow management and model
evaluation under one integrated platform.

Let me know if you're interested-happy to share more details.
